methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Bubble Robotics, a robotics and manufacturing company founded by Jean Crosetti and Patricia Apostol, operates within a defined competitive landscape of 9 sector peers (1 public, 8 private), including notable private companies such as Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. The company's stage and current valuation remain undisclosed, as does total capital raised to date.

The peer-median valuation method was not applicable to this analysis. Despite identifying 10 same-sector peers in Robotics & Manufacturing, the dataset yielded insufficient datapoints meeting narrower filtering criteria—specifically, zero same-stage comparables, zero adjacent-stage comparables, and zero similar-valuation-tier comparables. A threshold of three or more filtered datapoints is required for reliable peer-median triangulation; applying an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable basis-of-comparison risk given stage and maturity heterogeneity across the peer set.

No triangulated valuation range can be responsibly derived from the available data. A credible analysis would require either disclosure of Bubble Robotics' stage and recent financing metrics, enabling tighter peer stratification, or access to transaction multiples and financial performance data from the identified private peer universe. The presence of one public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ) may offer partial directional context but cannot serve as a primary anchor without stage-level filtering. Further diligence is necessary before advancing a valuation recommendation.
